title: Molecular dynamics simulations for the study of chromatin biology.
authors: Brandani, Giovanni B; Gopi, Soundhararajan; Yamauchi, Masataka; Takada, Shoji
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统回顾了分子动力学模拟在染色质生物学中的应用，涵盖核小体动态、染色质纤维组织及转录因子在染色质上的相互作用，虽非聚焦TF-DNA特异性结合建模，但MD方法及TF-染色质互作内容对本课题有直接借鉴价值。
abstract: The organization of Eukaryotic DNA into chromatin has profound implications for the processing of genetic information. In the past years, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations proved to be a powerful tool to investigate the mechanistic basis of chromatin biology. We review recent all-atom and coarse-grained MD studies revealing how the structure and dynamics of chromatin underlie its biological functions. We describe the latest method developments; the structural fluctuations of nucleosomes and the various factors affecting them; the organization of chromatin fibers, with particular emphasis on its liquid-like character; the interactions and dynamics of transcription factors on chromatin; and how chromatin organization is modulated by molecular motors acting on DNA.
abstract_zh: 真核生物DNA组织成染色质对遗传信息的处理具有深远影响。近年来，分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟已成为研究染色质生物学机制基础的有力工具。我们回顾了近期全原子和粗粒化MD研究，揭示了染色质的结构和动态如何支撑其生物学功能。我们描述了最新方法进展；核小体的结构波动及其影响因素；染色质纤维的组织，特别强调其液体样特性；转录因子在染色质上的相互作用与动态；以及作用于DNA的分子马达如何调节染色质组织。
